LanguageData.CardiacArrest.label: cardiac arrest
LanguageData.CardiacArrest.description: Circulation has stopped. Perform CPR; defibrillation works only in early arrest. A nonfunctional heart needs repair or replacement. With delayed vital failure, unprotected brain injury can become fatal in about 1.5 game hours, before the roughly three-hour arrest timer. Resuscitation does not erase brain injury.
